dct_title_s: Grenada, further particulars of valuable Sugar & Cocoa Estates : known as "Laura" and "Mount Gay," the latter including the Cocoa lands known as "Bon Accord," all in the Island of Grenada, containing together 1,068 acres or thereabouts, together with the buildings, fixtures, machinery, and live and dead stock thereon : which will be sold by auction, in two lots, by Messrs. Hards, Vaughan and Jenkinson, before James Fleming, Esq., Q.C., and Reginald John Cust, Esq., Commissioners for Sale of Incumbered Estates in the West Indies, at the Sale Room of the Commissioners
